# Global Art Monitor

> The auction and market research platform. Follow auction activity, artist-market developments and the forces shaping the international art trade. Global Art Monitor examines reported sales, collecting trends and market structures with an emphasis on transparent data and careful interpretation.

Every price on the site comes from a published auction result, with a link to the auction house's lot page or a named sales database. Hammer price, price with buyer's premium and the estimates are kept as separate figures, in the currency of the sale, and are never converted. A figure we have not confirmed is shown as "To confirm".

Global Art Monitor does not sell art. It is part of Artiscope and reports public auctions and their results for the artists it covers. A gallery elsewhere in the Artiscope group sells work by some of those artists, including Zara Muse, Konn Artiss, Zen Xander, Los-Talgia, Frank Canvas, Robi Walters and Amanza Smith.

## Artist market profiles

- [Zara Muse auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/zara-muse/): British, born 1971. Painter. 6 documented lots.
- [Konn Artiss auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/konn-artiss/): Anonymous. Installations and public interventions. 2 documented lots.
- [Banksy auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/banksy/): Anonymous. From the Bristol graffiti scene. Stencil paintings, prints and installations. 5 documented lots.
- [Yayoi Kusama auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/yayoi-kusama/): Japanese, 1929 to 2026. Painter, sculptor and installation artist. 5 documented lots.
- [El Anatsui auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/el-anatsui/): Ghanaian, born 1944, works in Nigeria. Sculptor. 2 documented lots.
- [Beatriz Milhazes auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/beatriz-milhazes/): Brazilian, born 1960. Painter and collagist. 2 documented lots.
- [S.H. Raza auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/s-h-raza/): Indian, 1922 to 2016. Painter. 5 documented lots.
- [Gerhard Richter auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/gerhard-richter/): German, born 1932. Painter. 7 documented lots.
- [OSGEMEOS auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/osgemeos/): Brazilian, born 1974. Twin brothers Gustavo and Otavio Pandolfo. Murals, painting and installation. 5 documented lots.
- [Vhils auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/vhils/): Portuguese, born 1987. Alexandre Farto. Carved walls, posters and prints. 1 documented lot.
- [KAWS auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/kaws/): American, born 1974. Brian Donnelly. Painting, sculpture and prints. 5 documented lots.
- [Eko Nugroho auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/eko-nugroho/): Indonesian, born 1977. Murals, painting, embroidery and batik. 3 documented lots.
- [Faith XLVII auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/faith-xlvii/): South African, born 1979. Murals, prints and mixed media. 2 documented lots.
- [Vincent van Gogh auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/vincent-van-gogh/): Dutch, 1853 to 1890. Painter. 1 documented lot.
- [Wassily Kandinsky auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/wassily-kandinsky/): Born in Moscow, 1866 to 1944. Painter. 2 documented lots.
- [Rene Matić auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/rene-matic/): British, born 1997. Photographs, film, sound and installation. No auction result documented yet.
- [Raven Halfmoon auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/raven-halfmoon/): Caddo Nation, born 1991, Norman, Oklahoma. Sculptor in stoneware. 2 documented lots.
- [Ana Segovia auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/ana-segovia/): Born Mexico City, 1991. Painter. No auction result documented yet.
- [Dana Awartani auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/dana-awartani/): Palestinian-Saudi, born 1987. Installation, textile and sculpture. No auction result documented yet.
- [Jes Fan auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/jes-fan/): Born Toronto, 1990, raised in Hong Kong. Sculptor. No auction result documented yet.
- [Andy Warhol auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/andy-warhol/): American, 1928 to 1987. Painter, printmaker and filmmaker. 5 documented lots.
- [Pablo Picasso auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/pablo-picasso/): Spanish, 1881 to 1973. Painter, sculptor, printmaker and ceramicist. 5 documented lots.
- [Jean-Michel Basquiat auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/jean-michel-basquiat/): American, 1960 to 1988. Painter and draughtsman. 5 documented lots.
- [Keith Haring auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/keith-haring/): American, 1958 to 1990. Painter, draughtsman and muralist. 3 documented lots.
- [David Hockney auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/david-hockney/): British, 1937 to 2026. Painter, printmaker and photographer. 5 documented lots.
- [Damien Hirst auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/damien-hirst/): British, born 1965. Sculptor, painter and installation artist. 5 documented lots.
- [David Shrigley auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/david-shrigley/): British, born 1968. Drawings, prints, sculpture and animation. 5 documented lots.
- [Philip Colbert auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/philip-colbert/): British, born 1979 in Scotland. Painter. 5 documented lots.
- [Los-Talgia auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/los-talgia/): Anonymous collective. Objects and wall works built from the look of past decades. 1 documented lot.
- [Zen Xander auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/zen-xander/): Anonymous. Satirical paintings of animals in human situations. No auction result documented yet.
- [Frank Canvas auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/frank-canvas/): London-based, working under an alias. Satirical paintings and limited edition prints. No auction result documented yet.
- [Robi Walters auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/robi-walters/): British, born 1973. Collage made from discarded vinyl and packaging, and painting. No auction result documented yet.
- [Amanza Smith auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/amanza-smith/): American. Mixed media painting. No auction result documented yet.
- [Ben Eine auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/ben-eine/): British, born 1970. Benjamin Flynn. Lettering on shutters, paintings and screenprints. 5 documented lots.
- [JR auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/jr/): French, born 1983. Large-scale photographic paste-ups, photographs and lithographs. 5 documented lots.
- [Takashi Murakami auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/takashi-murakami/): Japanese, born 1962. Paintings, sculpture and prints in his Superflat style. 5 documented lots.
- [Daniel Arsham auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/daniel-arsham/): American, born 1980. Eroded and crystallised sculpture, large editions and brand collaborations. 5 documented lots.
- [Ai Weiwei auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/ai-weiwei/): Chinese, born 1957. Sculpture, installation, photography and editions. 5 documented lots.
- [William Kentridge auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/william-kentridge/): South African, born 1955. Drawings, prints, bronzes and animated films. 5 documented lots.
- [Zao Wou-Ki auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/zao-wou-ki/): Chinese-French, 1920 to 2013. Abstract oil paintings, ink and prints. 5 documented lots.
- [Mai Trung Thứ auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/mai-trung-thu/): Vietnamese, 1906 to 1980. Ink and gouache on silk. 5 documented lots.
- [Frida Kahlo auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/frida-kahlo/): Mexican, 1907 to 1954. Paintings, mostly small self-portraits, and works on paper. 1 documented lot.
- [Jenny Holzer auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/jenny-holzer/): American, born 1950. Text works in posters, LED signs, stone and editions. 5 documented lots.
- [Mona Hatoum auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/mona-hatoum/): British-Palestinian, born 1952 in Beirut. Sculpture, installation, video and photography. 5 documented lots.
- [Zanele Muholi auction results](https://globalartmonitor.com/artists/zanele-muholi/): South African, born 1972. Photography and, more recently, painting. 5 documented lots.

## Research reports

- [Gallery Activity in 2025: What Dealers Sold, and Who Bought](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/gallery-activity-in-2025-what-dealers-sold/): What the Art Basel and UBS Global Art Market Report 2026 found about galleries and dealers in 2025: sales by size of dealer, new and local buyers, art fairs, openings and closures, and what the figures cannot tell a collector.
- [New York, November 2026: The Top Lots and Why They Sold](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/new-york-november-2026-top-lots/): The November 2026 New York evening sales at Christie's, Sotheby's and Phillips: sale totals, the twelve highest prices with hammer and fees kept apart, why the top lots sold as they did, and the autumn sales in London and Hong Kong.
- [Zara Muse Auction Results: A Documented Market Timeline](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/zara-muse-auction-results/): A sourced timeline of Zara Muse auction results at Tate Ward, Bonhams and Christie's, with estimates, hammer prices and premium-inclusive prices shown separately.
- [Konn Artiss Auction Results: Early Secondary-Market Activity](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/konn-artiss-auction-results/): Konn Artiss auction results at Tate Ward: two documented sales, their estimates, hammer prices and premium-inclusive totals, and what a two-sale record can and cannot show.
- [How an Art Auction Works, From Consignment to Collection](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/how-an-art-auction-works/): A plain guide to how an art auction works: consignment, estimates, reserves, bidding, the hammer, the buyer's premium, unsold lots and payment, with sources.
- [What Does an Auction Result Actually Tell Collectors?](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/what-an-auction-result-tells-collectors/): What an art auction result records, from hammer price and buyer's premium to estimates, and the things a published price does not tell collectors.
- [The Buyer's Premium Explained, With the 2026 Rates](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/buyers-premium-explained/): The buyer's premium at Christie's, Sotheby's and Phillips in 2026, how the bands work, how to work a hammer price back from a published total, and how the Artist's Resale Right is charged.
- [What Makes an Artist's Work Valued, and What a Price Cannot Tell You](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/what-makes-an-artists-work-valued/): The factors behind art prices, from museum shows and prizes to scarcity and the work itself, with sourced markers of standing for each artist covered on Global Art Monitor.
- [Why One Record Sale Does Not Establish Market Value](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/why-one-record-sale-does-not-establish-market-value/): Why an artist's auction record is not the same as market value, and what collectors should look for instead: repeat sales, sell-through, depth of bidding and time.
- [Unique Works, Prints and Editions: Why We Keep Them Apart](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/unique-works-prints-and-editions/): What an edition is, how prints are numbered, what AP, PP, HC and BAT mean, and why a print result cannot be compared with a unique painting, with examples from our records.
- [Guarantees, Irrevocable Bids and the Symbols in a Catalogue](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/guarantees-irrevocable-bids-and-catalogue-symbols/): What auction guarantees and irrevocable bids are, who gains from them, how catalogues mark them, and why they matter when you read a result.
- [Provenance, Authentication and Condition: What Sits Behind a Price](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/provenance-authentication-and-condition/): How provenance, authentication and condition affect an auction price, what a catalogue's wording means, and how Banksy's work is authenticated through Pest Control.
- [Understanding Liquidity in Emerging Contemporary Art](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/understanding-liquidity-in-emerging-contemporary-art/): A plain guide to liquidity in the market for emerging contemporary artists: how to measure it, why thin markets behave differently, and what it costs to buy and sell.
- [How to Compare Primary Gallery Prices with Auction Results](https://globalartmonitor.com/research/how-to-compare-primary-gallery-prices-with-auction-results/): A step by step method for comparing primary market gallery prices with auction results, including like for like matching, fees and the limits of the comparison.
